## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.5.0`
- Diagnostic Category: [`assist/source/useSortedEnumMembers`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- Sources: 
  - Inspired from [`@graphql-eslint/alphabetize`](https://the-guild.dev/graphql/eslint/rules/alphabetize)

## How to enable in your editor
<EditorAction includeFixAll action="source.action.useSortedEnumMembers.biome" />
## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"assist": {
		"actions": {
			"source": {
				"useSortedEnumMembers": "on"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Sort GraphQL enum values in natural order.

Natural order compares numbers by value, so `ROLE_9` comes before `ROLE_10`. It places
uppercase letters before lowercase letters when names otherwise match. Keeping values
sorted makes growing enums easier to scan and review.

## Examples

### Invalid

```graphql
enum Role {
  SUPER_ADMIN
  ADMIN
  USER
  GOD
}
```

```graphql
  ADMIN
  GOD
  SUPER_ADMIN
  USER
}
```
